fullPassage: You already have a business and you're about to launch your blog so that you can sell your product. Unfortunately, here is where a 'business mind' can be a bad thing. Most people believe that to have a successful business blog promoting a product, they have to stay strictly 'on the topic.' If all you're doing is shamelessly promoting your product, then who is going to want to read the latest thing you're writing about? Instead, you need to give some useful or entertaining information away for free so that people have a reason to keep coming back. Only by doing this can you create an interested audience that you will then be able to sell to. So, the best way to be successful with a business blog is to write about things that your audience will be interested in.

❌ ③ strict and formal(엄격하고 격식 있는): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ costly but rare(비싸지만 희귀한): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: 무료로 주는 정보는 독자에게 '유용하거나 재미있어야' 합니다.

questions.passage: You already have a business and you're about to launch your blog so that you can sell your product. Unfortunately, here is where a 'business mind' can be a bad thing. Most people believe that to have a successful business blog promoting a product, they have to stay strictly 'on the topic.' If all you're doing is shamelessly promoting your product, then who is going to want to read the latest thing you're writing about? Instead, you need to give some useful or entertaining information away for free so that people have a reason to keep coming back. Only by doing this can you create an interested audience that you will then be able to sell to. So, the best way to be successful with a business blog is to write about things that your audience will be interested in.

❌ ② 홍보가 유일한 방법: 무료 정보 제공을 권함
❌ ③ 관심사와 무관: 관심사에 맞추라고 함
✅ ④ 일치: 'the best way to be successful with a business blog is to write about things that your audience will be interested in' ← 정답
det.tip: 마지막 문장이 글의 결론이자 정답 근거입니다.

ch: 대부분의 사람들은 성공적인 블로그를 위해 주제에서 자유로워야 한다고 믿는다.

독자의 관심사는 블로그 내용 선정과 아무런 관련이 없다.
성공적인 블로그를 만드는 가장 좋은 방법은 독자가 관심 있어 할 내용을 쓰는 것이다.
